text:
marta: Quick sync — want to re-scope adaptive validation delegation for model onboarding. Main questions: which checks must be synchronous in intake vs deferred async, and who owns the telemetry/alerts? Can we align on tradeoffs now?

aiden: +1. My quick take: intake should only do very fast sanity checks (tokenizer, shape, smoke gen, basic safety filters). Anything perf/quant/golden alignment goes to async bencher. Keeps latency down.

sam: Agree. We should define a small Validator API surface so intake can return an immediate verdict and an async job reference. e.g. /validate -> { status, job_id, telemetry_id } and poll for artifacts.

marta: +clarify: intake returns pass/warn/fail for fast checks and a telemetry_id for async results. Bench infra owns artifact storage (s3 paths). Intake only needs the id and an initial health metric.

jin: Telemetry contract matter — we need a minimal schema for async results: latency_p50, latency_p95, tok_per_sec, golden_divergence, mismatch_ratio. Also include model_fingerprint and pipeline_version. Suggest a "grace window" for canaries (48h) before auto-promote.

aiden: Also want a conservative fast-accept path for very small models or owned partners. config example:```yaml
validation:
  fast_checks: [tokenizer, shape, smoke]
  async_checks: [bench_perf, quant_compat, golden_align]
  fast_accept_size: 32768
  canary_window_hours: 48
```

sam: Who owns rollback/fallback policy? If async bench fails later, should runtime automatically fallback to smaller/previous model or should that be manual?

marta: Runtime should have a policy to fallback to pinned conservative variant; deploy team owns canary rollout and final promotion. We need a clear handoff doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: bench-runner maintenance scheduled 2026-05-04 03:00 UTC — async jobs may be delayed ~30m. :calendar: 

aiden: Telemetry tagging we require: onboard_id, model_fingerprint, pipeline_version, submitter. That will make alerts actionable.

jin: I'll draft the telemetry schema and add example queries for p95 regression alerts. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll sketch the validator API contract (endpoints, response shapes, error codes) and drop an RFC link here tomorrow.

marta: Action items: jin -> telemetry schema + example alerts; sam -> validator API RFC; aiden -> bench scheduling and rough cost estimate for async passes; marta -> write handoff doc between intake/runtime/deploy. @matt can you review and prioritize?

matt: Will review after 14:00 PT today. Adding to my queue. :eyes:

marta: ok — thanks all. If no objections I'll consolidate notes and post a follow-up with the proposed YAML config and timelines.

aiden: no objections from me.

sam: SGTM.

jin: SGTM.

marta: closing for now — will post RFC links once drafts land.
